metadata.description: Linear A sign registry: one record per sign, with its readings, Unicode rendering, SigLA image, Cretan Hieroglyphic and Linear B lineage, and the words of Gordon 1966's index that use it, in Gordon's transliteration and sign values. The readings are the Linear B values and four other signs' values; every value beyond Linear B is in sign_values.json, and each reading here carries its status there.

Gordon 1966, Evidence for the Minoan Language, §163 (index of Minoan words)

unicode_alias_conflict.reason: U+10641 is LINEAR A SIGN AB080. VIR is A100-102 (U+10647), the figure sign the compounds A568–A572 build on.
U+10646 is LINEAR A SIGN AB087. Unicode encodes VIN only as the variants AB131A, AB131B and A131C (U+1064D–U+1064F), with no base code point.
